verifications.claim: No Kings Day is a series of nationwide and largely peaceful protest rallies in the U.S.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "No Kings is a peaceful movement with more than 2,500 events nationwide" (R1); "‘No Kings’ demonstrations took place from coast to coast... largely peaceful protests" (R2); "over seven million Americans joined 2,700+ events in all 50 states" (R3); "third No Kings Day" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources describe repeated nationwide peaceful protests across events in June, October 2025, and March 2026.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day is designed to oppose perceived authoritarianism and policies of the Trump administration.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "protest the Trump administration’s corruption and blatant disregard for the law" (R1); "against President Donald Trump’s policies" (R2); "sustained national resistance to tyranny" (R3); "standing together in nonviolent defiance of authoritarianism" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state opposition to Trump's authoritarianism, corruption, and policies.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day draws millions across all 50 states.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "millions turned out... over 5 million people across the United States" (R1); "over seven million Americans... in all 50 states" (R3); "Estimated 8 Million Turn Out... across the country" (R4); "more than seven million people across all 50 states" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm millions attending events in all 50 states across multiple dates.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day emphasizes that the country belongs to its people rather than kings.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "power belongs to the people... America does not do kings. We’re not ruled, we’re represented" (R1); "this country does not belong to kings... It belongs to We the People" (R3); "this nation belongs to its people, not to kings" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Core messaging in sources directly matches the emphasis on people power over kings.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day features nationwide rallies featuring protests in over 2,700 cities.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2,700+ events in all 50 states" (R3); "over 2,700 cities and towns" (R4); "more than 2,700 events taking place nationwide" (R6); "over 3,000 local events... more than 2,700 events last October" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly cite over 2,700 events/cities/towns for October 2025 event, part of the series.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day protests were held in October 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "No Kings protest on October 18" (R1, dated 10/18/25 context); "On October 18, over seven million" (R3); "10/20/25... No Kings Day of Action" (R4); "October 18, 2025" (R6)

verifications.claim: No Kings Day protests were held in March 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "2026 Update: ... next No Kings protest on March 28" (R1); "March 28, 2026 — ‘No Kings’ protests" (R2); "3/30/26... Third No Kings Day" (R4); "March 28, 2026" (R7)

verifications.claim: No Kings Day protests often target federal immigration enforcement (ICE), the cost of living, and executive actions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "end immigration enforcement blitzes... rising cost of living" (R2); "targeting immigrant families... driving up the cost of living" (R3); "ICE’s Deadly Actions... rising cost of living" (R4); "Abusive immigration enforcement... cost of living" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources repeatedly mention ICE/immigration enforcement and cost of living; executive actions implied in abuses of power.

verifications.claim: The No Kings Day movement uses digital platforms to organize rallies in both major cities and smaller towns.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lcv.org/nokings... virtual safety trainings and messaging toolkits" (R1); "from small towns to city centers" (R3); "Twitch to Mobilize... nokings.org" (R4); "Interactive map of locations available at NoKings.org... from every corner" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe websites, Twitch, toolkits for organizing in cities and towns.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day participants often wave American flags and chant against the Trump administration.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Break out your flags... Patriotic Sign Ideas... lots of red, white and blue" (R1); "wave signs... marching, singing" (R2); "shouted by millions, carried on posters and chants" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Flags explicitly encouraged; chanting implied in protests against Trump, but not directly stated as 'chant against the Trump administration'.

verifications.claim: No Kings Day organizers and participants include union members such as AFSCME
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "AFSCME President Lee Saunders... On No Kings Day, working families... defend our union freedoms" (R8); unions like SEIU, AFT listed (R8); "working families" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: AFSCME explicitly quoted as participating; other unions confirmed.
